Population.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/5] There are 120 adult male prisons in England and Wales. It was therefore necessary to decide which prisons should be included in the study. The Ministry of Justice Safer Custody and Offender Policy Group at the Home Office calculated that 19 prisons were likely, based on past rates of completed suicide and serious suicide attempts, to provide 60 near-lethal suicide attempts within the time period allocated for data collection.
